name: Vinylla
intro: [happy] Oh! The sound engineer. Cass said you’d bounced. I love a comeback; they chart so well.
You know what I’m pressing. A lid for the sun, gold on one side. Light, by subscription.
[angry] People pay for scarcity. I’m making the scarcest thing there is.
[happy] Let’s do a little soundcheck, darling.
win: “How rude. It doesn’t matter. The press is at the Inner Sun, and I’m late for my own release.”
hint: Vinylla is at the top of Skygarden Walk with a team around level 61–63.
